scope: Five final daytime connecting-flight frames at 108, 125, 141, 157 and 177 seconds; Cloud Gate and Pavilion park segment only.
method: Each exact PNG listed below was opened with view_image and actually inspected. Hashes were calculated from these final sampled files. No source changes, GPU commands, new renders or image edits were performed.

images.finding: Aerial Grainger Plaza composition clearly frames Cloud Gate, mapped plaza/tree allees and the Millennium Monument; no foreground camera obstruction.
Oblique Cloud Gate view preserves the rounded steel silhouette and arch, with continuous curved skyline/paving reflections; Pavilion headdress is visible behind the plaza.
Broad-side Cloud Gate view remains fully framed and unobstructed, with smooth skyline reflection band, readable reflected paving and concave underside.
The elevated Pavilion approach clears the tree crowns and exposes the broad curved steel headdress, dark stage, acoustic trellis, speakers and rows of seats.
The stage and seating are centered under the trellis; tubular beams cross the scene as intended architecture without accidentally hiding the stage or headdress.

findings: Cloud Gate and the Pavilion remain clearly framed without accidental scene geometry obstructing the featured landmarks in the five inspected samples.
Cloud Gate reflection outlines are continuous and readable; the earlier scalloped mirror-normal artifact is absent.
The top-left From tower to museum title and continuous-flight caption remain legible and clear of the featured landmarks, and the bottom OpenStreetMap attribution is legible in every inspected frame.
No gross frame corruption, missing landmark, oversized isolated firefly bloom or camera-inside-solid artifact is visible in these samples.
limitations: This is a five-frame visual sample review, not continuous playback or a frame-by-frame temporal assessment. Full-movie decode/frame-count/timing validation and earlier flight/museum footage are handled separately.
Residual fine sampling grain is visible in Cloud Gate lower-shell reflections and some shiny surfaces; these frames are not noise-free.
Solid simplified tree crowns, repeated generic surrounding facades and the reference-interpreted Pavilion ribbon form remain visible approximations.
